https://healthcarecareercollege.edu/ Healthcare Career College started in 1990. We provide a fast career pathway to employment in the healthcare industry by providing programs in Vocational Nursing, Medical Assistant, Ultrasound Technician e.t.c. We are accredited by the Council on Occupational Education, Approved by the Department of Education, the California Bureau of Private Post secondary Education, the Veteran’s Affairs Administration, the Workforce Development Board, and we offer a free high school diploma program and financial aid. Call us at 562-804-1239 to find out how to get started! 

Follow us today!
